📊 Case study · Cycle Count Recheck

Monthly cycle counts kept turning up miscounts, and rechecking every asset tag by hand — one by one against the WMS export — was slow and still error-prone. I combined a barcode scanner with an Excel formula that auto-verifies each scan: =IF(COUNTIF(range,criteria),"Match","Error"). Scan a tag, and it's instantly flagged against the WMS list — no manual lookup, no missed mismatches.

📊 Case study · Packing Line Redesign

After the cell-packing line was relocated between floors, I mapped every step in Excel using a Flow Process Chart, then applied ECRS to cut out waste — two changes made most of the difference:

  • Eliminate — the tray-cleaning step (756.8 sec) was removed entirely once the new layout kept trays protected between uses.
  • Simplify — cells no longer had to be lifted by hand onto the table (126 sec); the redesigned table added a roller track so cells slide into place instead (72 sec).

13 steps → 12 · 2,200.3 sec → 1,389.5 sec of cycle time, per the process chart.
